title: Cartwise Grocery Orders Handoff Standard: Alcohol and Undeliverable Orders
content:
## Handoff standard: alcohol and undeliverable orders — Cartwise Grocery Orders

Store and handoff operations settings for each Cartwise Grocery Orders service level: whether alcohol can be ordered, the fee when alcohol is taken back after a failed ID check, how an undeliverable or uncollected order is returned, and how much is refunded on a returned order.

| Service level | Alcohol lines can be ordered | Alcohol return fee | Contact attempts before return | Wait before return | Share of item charges refunded on a returned order | Fees refunded on a returned order |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | yes | 0.00 USD | 0 (not applicable) | 240 minutes (hold time) | 0 percent | no |
| No-Rush Delivery | yes | 7.00 USD | 3 | 10 minutes | 50 percent | no |
| Standard Delivery | yes | 7.00 USD | 3 | 10 minutes | 50 percent | no |
| Priority Delivery | yes | 7.00 USD | 3 | 10 minutes | 50 percent | no |
| Express 30 Delivery | no | 0.00 USD | 3 | 10 minutes | 50 percent | no |
| Stock-Up Delivery | yes | 7.00 USD | 3 | 15 minutes | 50 percent | no |

### Column definitions

- **Alcohol return fee** — the fee billed when alcohol is returned because the ID check failed at handoff.
- **Contact attempts before return** — the attempts to reach the customer before an undeliverable order is returned; 0 marks the setting as not applicable (Curbside Pickup).
- **Wait before return** — for a delivery service level, the minutes the shopper waits at the address before an undeliverable order is returned; for Curbside Pickup, the hold time before an uncollected order is returned.
- **Share refunded on a returned order** — the percentage of item charges refunded when the order is returned; perishables are never refunded.
- **Fees refunded on a returned order** — whether fees are refunded when the order is returned; it reads no at every service level.

### Hypothetical reading

A hypothetical returned Standard Delivery order with a non-perishable line charged 12.00 USD reads 50 percent in the table, that is 6.00 USD for that line; the same line on a returned Curbside Pickup order reads 0 percent.
